susuwatariSize.help: Controls the base size of each Susuwatari sprite

susuwatariCount.help: Number of Susuwatari sprites on screen

fleeDistance.help: How close the mouse can get before Susuwatari start fleeing

fleeAcceleration.help: How fast Susuwatari accelerate when fleeing from the mouse

audioIntensity.help: Controls how much the spikes react to audio frequencies

bassPulseIntensity.help: Controls how much the eyes pulse with bass frequencies

audioVisualizationEnabled.help: Master toggle for all audio-reactive effects

maxRunDistance.help: Distance Susuwatari can run before getting tired

sleepTime.help: Time before Susuwatari fall asleep when mouse is still

sleepEnabled.help: Allow Susuwatari to fall asleep when mouse is inactive

restTimeout.help: Time to rest when Susuwatari become dizzy from rapid mouse movement

zigzagMinDistance.help: Minimum distance from Susuwatari required to trigger zigzag scatter effect

backgroundImageUrl.help: Enter a URL to a background image (e.g., https://example.com/image.jpg). For local files, use the Folder Dropdown (Lively) or FilePicker (Wallpaper Engine)

backgroundImagePicker.help: Select a background image from the backgrounds folder or use the file picker to add new images
